title: InflaRx Announces November Investor Events
body_markdown:
**Jena, Germany, October 27, 2026** – InflaRx N.V. (Nasdaq: IFRX), a biopharmaceutical company pioneering anti-inflammatory therapeutics by targeting the complement system, today announced its events calendar for November.


**Guggenheim Securities 3rd Annual Healthcare Innovation Conference**


November 9 - 11, 2026 in Boston, MA


Fireside chat on November 10 at 9:30 AM EST


InflaRx will also conduct one-on-one investor meetings on November 10th. A link to view the fireside chat live stream and its replay is availablehere .


**Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference**


November 16 – 19, 2026 in London, UK


One-on-one investor meetings


Jefferies will organize one-on-one investor meetings with InflaRx on November 16th and 17th.


**Third quarter 2026 earnings and operating results**


The Company will report its **third quarter 2026 financial and operating results on November 3** , **2026** , before the market opens, via a Form 6-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). An update regarding quarterly results will be included during the Capital Markets Day.


**Capital Markets Day**


As previously announced, **InflaRx will host a virtual Capital Markets Event on November 3, 2026** , from 8:00 AM EST / 2:00 PM CET to approximately 9:00 AM EST / 3:00 PM CET. Featuring leading experts in the fields of ANCA-associated vasculitis (AAV) and complement inhibition, the event will provide an overview of the evolving treatment landscape and unmet need in AAV, and how izicopan’s differentiated chemistry, metabolic properties, and potential safety advantages could improve upon the existing standard of care in AAV.


The event will also provide updated thinking on InflaRx’s development strategy in AAV, including an overview of the anticipated clinical program. The event will feature presentations from members of InflaRx’s management team and invited external experts, followed by a question-and-answer session. To participate in the virtual event, participants are requested to pre-registerhere to receive an invite link and dial-in details to access the event.


***About InflaRx***


InflaRx (Nasdaq: IFRX) is a biopharmaceutical company pioneering anti-inflammatory therapeutics by applying its proprietary anti-C5a and anti-C5aR technologies to discover, develop and commercialize highly potent and specific inhibitors of the complement activation factor C5a and its receptor, C5aR. C5a is a powerful inflammatory mediator involved in the progression of a wide variety of inflammatory diseases. InflaRx‘s lead program is izicopan, an orally administered small molecule inhibitor of C5a-induced signaling via the C5a receptor, which has shown promising PK/PD characteristics as well as therapeutic potential in Phase 1 and Phase 2a clinical studies. The Company is developing izicopan for the treatment of ANCA-associated vasculitis and additional renal diseases. InflaRx also has developed vilobelimab, a novel, intravenously delivered, first-in-class, anti-C5a monoclonal antibody that selectively binds to free C5a and has demonstrated disease-modifying clinical activity and tolerability in multiple clinical studies.


InflaRx and the group have offices and subsidiaries in Jena and Munich, Germany, as well as Ann Arbor, MI, USA. For further information, please visit[www.inflarx.de](https://www.inflarx.de/) . Follow InflaRx on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/inflarx/) . InflaRx GmbH (Germany) and InflaRx Pharmaceuticals Inc. (USA) are wholly owned subsidiaries of InflaRx N.V. (together, InflaRx).
